title: rally wake-due response
description: B4: trust-gated wake eligibility projection. Lists standby facts whose wake_after has passed. Emits suggested_command strings only — rally never executes anything.

due.description: Standbys whose wake_after has passed and whose owner is a known room participant.

reason.description: Human-readable reason from reason: marker in summary.

wake_after.description: ISO-8601 wake_after timestamp that has passed.

suggested_command.description: Suggested shell command string for the external runner to invoke. Rally never executes this.
